data.name: Uchi No Heya!
data.detailed_description:
Run a sumo stable! Recruit rookies, drill their stats, cook chanko nabe, and steer them through six grand tournaments a year. In this sumo sim, you climb the banzuke from Jonokuchi to Yokozuna while juggling injuries, rivalries, and an empty bank account. Work hard to make your heya legendary!

Uchi No Heya! is a comprehensive sumo management simulator that puts you in control of your own stable. It runs through everything you would expect out of a good sumo simulator! All sumo divisions, all kimarite, and small details like special promotion/demotion logic for sekiwake/ozeki/yokozuna. In hardcore mode the difficulty is aimed more toward real world difficulty, with only the best of the best reaching the top!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4300 / equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: WebGL2-capable integrated GPU — Intel HD Graphics 4000, AMD Radeon HD 7000-series, NVIDIA GeForce 600-series
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: Mouse + keyboard or gamepad controller. 1280×720 minimum display resolution recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (8th gen+) / AMD Ryzen 3 / equivalent
  • Graphics: any modern GPU with WebGL2 — Intel Iris Xe, AMD Radeon, NVIDIA GeForce 1050+, or comparable
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: Mouse + keyboard or gamepad controller. 1280×720 minimum display resolution recommended.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (2015+)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any Metal-capable GPU (integrated is fine)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Universal build — runs native on Apple Silicon and Intel
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 (Monterey) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or newer / Intel Core i5 (2018+)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon integrated, or any discrete/integrated Metal GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / Debian 11 / Fedora 36 / SteamOS 3.5+ (glibc 2.28 or newer, 64-bit)
  • Processor: Any x86-64 dual-core ≥ 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: WebGL2-capable GPU with Mesa drivers
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: compatible audio device
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS / Fedora 39 / SteamOS 3.6+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (8th gen+) / AMD Ryzen 3 / Steam Deck APU / equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any modern GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: compatible audio device
